purpose: Evaluate the frozen no-view counterfactual-evidence adapter on existing exact-pose CARLA Epic native-fog features after, and only after, the local_glare transfer gate passes.

score.component_reduction: mean of the three predicted evidence-loss components

checks: fog_heavy score mean > fog_light score mean
score versus paired-clear patch delta Spearman >= 0.10 at both fog levels
score AUROC for top-20-percent paired-delta patches >= 0.60 at both fog levels
paired-clear delta mean is positive and fog_heavy > fog_light
fog_heavy > fog_light > clear independently on both routes

scope.reason_not_confirmation: This Epic fog family was used in earlier architecture-development diagnostics, although not by this adapter optimizer or checkpoint selection.

decision.pass: Proceed to a minimum closed-loop mechanism experiment with an independently fixed corruption event window and oracle plus learned conditions.
decision.fail: Stop before closed-loop adapter integration and revise the Stage-1 supervision diversity.
